accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.description: A set of collapsible panels with headings.

alert-dialog.name: Alert Dialog
alert-dialog.description: A dialog that interrupts to ask for a decision.

autocomplete.name: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: A text input that suggests what to type.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.description: A picture of a user, with a fallback while it loads or when it fails.

button.name: Button
button.description: A button that can stay focusable while disabled, or be another element.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: A month grid for choosing a day, or a range of days.

checkbox-group.name: Checkbox Group
checkbox-group.description: A set of checkboxes that share one value: the list of the checked ones.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.description: A native checkbox that can be styled whole, with an optional indicator.

collapsible.name: Collapsible
collapsible.description: A panel that its trigger shows and hides.

combobox.name: Combobox
combobox.description: An input that filters a list of options to choose from.

context-menu.name: Context Menu
context-menu.description: A menu that opens at the pointer on a right-click or a long press.

date-field.name: Date Field
date-field.description: A date typed or stepped one segment at a time, in the locale's order.

date-picker.name: Date Picker
date-picker.description: A date field with a calendar in a popup, behind one value.

date-range-picker.name: Date Range Picker
date-range-picker.description: Two date fields with a range calendar in a popup, behind one range.

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.description: A popup that opens on top of the entire page.

drawer.name: Drawer
drawer.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen and can be swiped away.

field.name: Field
field.description: Labels a control, describes it, validates it and shows its errors.

fieldset.name: Fieldset
fieldset.description: A native fieldset that groups fields under a legend and disables them together.

file-upload.name: File Upload
file-upload.description: Choosing files through the browser's picker or by dropping them, with a list of what was chosen.

form.name: Form
form.description: A native form that validates its fields, waits for the server and shows the errors it returns.

input.name: Input
input.description: A native text input that works with Field.

listbox.name: Listbox
listbox.description: An always-visible list of options to select one or several from.

menu.name: Menu
menu.description: A list of actions in a popup, opened from a button and driven from the keyboard.

menubar.name: Menubar
menubar.description: A row of menus, as at the top of a desktop application.

meter.name: Meter
meter.description: A measurement within a known range, such as disk usage or a battery level.

navigation-menu.name: Navigation Menu
navigation-menu.description: A site's main links, with panels of more links that open from it.

number-field.name: Number Field
number-field.description: A text input for numbers, with buttons and a scrub area to step the value.

otp-field.name: OTP Field
otp-field.description: A one-time code entered one character per slot.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.description: Previous and next, numbered pages and ellipses, for moving through a long list.

popover.name: Popover
popover.description: An accessible popup anchored to a button.

preview-card.name: Preview Card
preview-card.description: A card that previews what a link points to while the link is hovered or focused.

progress.name: Progress
progress.description: Shows how far a task that takes a while has got.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: A set of native radios of which one is checked.

scroll-area.name: Scroll Area
scroll-area.description: A native scroll container with scrollbars you draw yourself.

segmented-control.name: Segmented Control
segmented-control.description: A row of segments of which one is always chosen.

select.name: Select
select.description: A button that opens a list of options to choose a value from.

separator.name: Separator
separator.description: A line that divides content, horizontally or vertically.

slider.name: Slider
slider.description: A range input with any number of thumbs that you can style.

sortable.name: Sortable
sortable.description: A list whose items can be reordered by drag and drop, with the pointer or the keyboard.

splitter.name: Splitter
splitter.description: Panels separated by bars that resize them, with a pointer or the keyboard.

switch.name: Switch
switch.description: A native checkbox with the switch role, for a setting that is on or off.

table-of-contents.name: Table of Contents
table-of-contents.description: A list of links to a document's sections that marks the one being read.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.description: A set of panels on the same page, one shown at a time.

tags-input.name: Tags Input
tags-input.description: A text input that turns what is typed into a list of removable tags.

time-field.name: Time Field
time-field.description: A time of day typed or stepped one segment at a time, in the locale's hour cycle.

time-picker.name: Time Picker
time-picker.description: A time field with a popup of hours, minutes and AM/PM to choose from.

time-range-picker.name: Time Range Picker
time-range-picker.description: A start and an end time, each with its own picker, in one group.

toast.name: Toast
toast.description: Short messages that appear without taking focus and go away by themselves.

toggle-group.name: Toggle Group
toggle-group.description: A set of toggles that share one state.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: A button that is either pressed or not.

toolbar.name: Toolbar
toolbar.description: A row of buttons and controls that is one stop for the Tab key.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.description: A short label that appears when a button is hovered or focused.
